lines.trans: Don't, Edik.
I think I can guess why we are here.
Do you feel something for him?
What nonsense is that? Edik, I just feel sorry for him.
No, it all makes sense. He charmed you.
Of course!

Stop it! Nobody charmed me.
Nobody? Not even me?
Enough, Edik! I'm the one who should be offended.
Forgive me, it's my fault.
Forgive me, I will make up for my fault.
